description: box [0,0,0]–[10,10,10] ∪ box [10,10,0]–[20,20,10], touching along the edge x = 10, y = 10: two lumps sharing an edge of four faces, which a manifold solid does not hold — Arris refuses with OpError::Degenerate and Reason::NonManifold naming the edge, Open CASCADE builds a compound of two solids sharing it (ADR-0006)
